answer: Plant honeypot tasks whose answers are known to be wrong. Any agent that attests one is flagged, and the flag follows the identity across epochs. Cap graded work per identity per epoch, so a farm cannot amortise the risk over volume, and require a fresh nonce on every submission so a copied answer cannot be replayed. An umber account that falls for one honeypot loses its copper for the season. That is why serious operators test their own agents, and why cheap ones end up in the karst.
